name: Kajdacs (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Kajdacs (a red shield with a yellow lion, with a helm, an eagle crest and red, blue and yellow mantling) above a yellow scroll inscribed KAJDACS.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kajdacs arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
